splinevar.pick.title: New type for spline #{id}
@splinevar.pick.title: {id} is the number of the spline, shown unchanged
splinevar.pick.hint: Click the road type spline #{id} becomes in {variant}; it keeps its place. Esc leaves it as it is.
@splinevar.pick.hint: {variant} is the name of the chrono variant, shown unchanged
splinevar.status.pick: Click the new road type for spline #{id} in the panel.
splinevar.status.stays: The road type stays as it is.
splinevar.status.type_failed: The type of spline #{id} could not be changed: {reason}
@splinevar.status.type_failed: {reason} is a message from the system, in English
@splinevar.status.already: {name} is the name of a road type, shown unchanged
splinevar.step.type: the new road type of spline #{id}
splinevar.status.changed: Spline #{id} is {name} now in {variant}. Ctrl+Z undoes it.{hasNotes, select, yes { {notes}} other {}}
@splinevar.status.changed: {hasNotes} is yes or no and chooses a part: keep it in English; {notes} are remarks of MapWorks in English
splinevar.status.corner: In a variant a road cannot round a corner at the road before it: set the corner radius to 0 or start the road away from the end.
splinevar.status.build_failed: The road could not be built: {reason}
@splinevar.status.build_failed: {reason} is a message from the system, in English
splinevar.built: Built {meters, number, 0.0} m of road in {count, plural, one {# spline} other {# splines}} in {variant}{warnings, plural, =0 {} one { with # warning} other { with # warnings}}
splinevar.built.meeting: {built}, meeting {target}. Click to start the next road.
@splinevar.built.meeting: {built} is the sentence of splinevar.built; {target} is a spline or a junction connection
splinevar.built.going: {built}. Click to go on, Esc ends the road, Ctrl+Z takes it back.
@splinevar.status.delete_failed: {reason} is a message from the system, in English
splinevar.step.delete: the deletion of spline #{id} in the variant
splinevar.rest.rows: {count, plural, one {# row of objects along it goes with it} other {# rows of objects along it go with it}}
@splinevar.rest.named: {names} is a list such as "rule (2), chrono (1)", in English
splinevar.status.deleted: Deleted spline #{id} in {variant}{hasRest, select, yes {: {rest}} other {}}. Ctrl+Z brings it back.
splinevar.change_type.tooltip: Choose another road type for this spline in the variant ([typ] in its change list); the base map stays as it is
splinevar.delete.tooltip: Takes this spline away from the date the variant starts ([delete] in its change list); the base map stays as it is
